question: Once an Assassin or commander I control has dealt combat damage to a player, can I cast spells for their freerunning costs for the rest of the turn even if that creature leaves the battlefield?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it does not matter what happens to the Assassin or commander after it deals combat damage.
expected.answer: Once an Assassin creature or commander you control deals combat damage to a player in a turn, you can cast spells for their freerunning costs for the rest of that turn. It doesn’t matter what happens to that Assassin or commander after that.
